assets.name: PDF.js (pdfjs-dist)
assets.used_in: renders one page of an original upstream deck on the slide-notes pages when the reader asks; build/pdf.min.mjs and build/pdf.worker.min.mjs are copied unmodified into overrides/assets/pdfjs/ with the package LICENSE; overrides/assets/stylesheets/slide-viewer.css reuses the text-layer rules of web/pdf_viewer.css
assets.read_with: gh api repos/mozilla/pdf.js/license (spdx Apache-2.0, LICENSE blob f433b1a); npm view pdfjs-dist@6.5.438 (license Apache-2.0, gitHead 0a41533 = tag v6.5.438); tarball sha512 matched dist.integrity; the vendored LICENSE hashes to the same blob f433b1a
assets.notes: Loaded from this site only, on the first click; no third-party script runs. Apache-2.0 has no NOTICE requirement here: pdfjs-dist ships no NOTICE file.
